in_hebrew.name: Tillie
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Tillie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word 'tilie' meaning 'rejoicing'. The name Tillie is a variation of the name Tilly, which has been in use since the Middle Ages. In Christian tradition, Tillie can be associated with the virtues of faith, hope, and charity.
